status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Correct the mistaken face-turn controls, split settings into collapsible custom and preset panels, and add the intended viewpoint transformation after its orientation contract is established.

CIF and EIF retain independent viewpoint token sequences.
